beats.caption: A detector gives you a pile of boxes, not one per object.
One dog, three boxes — each with its own confidence score.
First we need a way to measure how much two boxes overlap.
IoU = shared area ÷ combined area. Above 0.5 → same object.
NMS keeps the top box and drops every overlapping neighbour.
0.91 wins. The other two overlap the winner heavily — out.
Repeat with the next best box until every box is kept or dropped.
The whole algorithm: sort by score, keep the best, filter the rest.
The entire trick: survivors must overlap the winner less than 0.5.
Score them. Overlap them. Keep the best, drop the rest.
